name: TeamPulse
tagline: Channel-based team messaging with threads, reactions, and direct voice calls
description:
A modern Slack clone offering threaded messaging, channel management, member permissions, real-time message editing, file attachments, and 1-on-1 direct conversations.

Prompt-engineered and vibecoded in a 48-hour session using Cursor with Convex handling instant sync and optimistic UI updates without any REST polling.

replaces.note: Replaces Slack's 90-day message history limit with unlimited self-hosted logs.
